title: troia-ics: Provocation Testing for Dormant Supply-Chain Triggers in Industrial Control Systems — code and dataset
description: Code, container definitions, and the full experimental record accompanying the IEEE Access manuscript 'Pre-Deployment Provocation of Dormant Supply-Chain Triggers in Industrial Control Systems'. The record covers all 144 runs executed for the article: 40 main-matrix runs (baseline, malformed, mutate, replay; ten iterations each) and 104 binary-separation runs, each as per-sample JSONL streams plus per-channel summary JSON. The analysed sample is 140 of those, namely the 40-run matrix plus 20 runs per arm for Class 1 (data-conditioned) and 15 per arm for Classes 2 (sequence-conditioned) and 3 (environment-conditioned); the remaining four are a smoke sweep that preceded the amendment fixing 15 per arm and are published so that their exclusion can be checked. Also included: the OpenPLC v3 program with the hidden contextual trigger, three observability collectors feeding four measurement channels, the Isolation Forest reference detector, the windowed 2-sigma and 3-sigma rule baselines, the ablation / cross-validation / seed-sensitivity / ROC-sweep analysis pipeline, the pre-registration document with its 2026-05-19 amendment, and all aggregated CSV and JSON summaries. Packet captures are not redistributed; the protocol-channel features derived from them are.
